app.title: Markiro — Station
app.stationPurpose: Code verification, aggregation, and label printing on the production line.

windowMode.confirmDetail: Production continues and only the window mode changes. The operator, active shift, and queued work stay in place.

legacyIdentity.title: Station service required
legacyIdentity.resolving: Updating station identity. Cached offline work remains available.

legacyIdentity.rejected: This legacy station key could not prove its device identity. Local work is preserved; contact service support before pairing again.
